title: Frame cofibration pushout product with simplicial trivial cofibrations
statement: Use model categories, cofibrant objects, cosimplicial frames and their Reedy cofibrations as in [lem-coef-cosimplicial-frame-mapping] and [lem-coef-reedy-model-structure], and simplicial sets with their Kan–Quillen model structure (cofibrations the monomorphisms, weak homotopy equivalences, trivial cofibrations) as in [lem-coef-kan-quillen-right-proper]. Let $\mathcal M$ be a model category with functorial factorizations, and let $A^\bullet$ and $B^\bullet$ be cosimplicial frames on cofibrant objects $A$ and $B$. Let $f:A^\bullet\to B^\bullet$ be a Reedy cofibration. For a simplicial set $K$, let $A^\bullet\otimes K=\operatorname{colim}_{(\Delta^n\to K)}A^n$ be the colimit of $A^\bullet$ over the category of simplices of $K$ (equivalently the coend $\int^{[r]\in\Delta}\coprod_{K_r}A^r$), functorial in $A^\bullet$ and $K$, with $A^\bullet\otimes\Delta^n\cong A^n$; by the universal property of colimits it satisfies $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal M}(A^\bullet\otimes K,Y)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathrm{sSet}}(K,H(A^\bullet,Y))$, naturally in $A^\bullet$, $K$ and $Y$, where $H(A^\bullet,Y)_n=\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal M}(A^n,Y)$. Define $B^\bullet\otimes K$ similarly. For every trivial cofibration $i:K\to L$ of simplicial sets, the induced pushout-product map $$(A^\bullet\otimes L)\amalg_{A^\bullet\otimes K}(B^\bullet\otimes K)\longrightarrow B^\bullet\otimes L$$ is a trivial cofibration in $\mathcal M$.

source.place: Hovey, Model categories, Proposition 5.4.3, printed pp.130-131 (PDF pp.139-140), first clause; the tensor $A^\bullet\otimes K$ and its adjunction are those of Proposition 3.1.5 (Section 3.1) and Remark 5.2.9.
